time_basis: dates use one fixed clock for the whole log (no per-play timezone or daylight saving was kept), so this is only roughly local time
caveat: the export holds very little before february 2022 (253 plays over 44 days). on any date, a quiet or empty day says more about what the export kept than about listening. runs of three or more empty days from february 2022 on are smoothed: their neighbors' plays are spread across them, so no multi-day silence is readable here.
